# google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator

An OnlineEvaluator contains the configuration for an Online Evaluation. It
periodically samples traces or sessions emitted by an agent and evaluates them
using the configured metric sources.


To get more information about OnlineEvaluator, see:

* [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/reference/rest#rest-resource:-v1beta1.projects.locations.onlineevaluators)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/optimize/evaluation/evaluate-online)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Online Evaluator Basic


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_reasoning_engine" "engine" {
  display_name = "reasoning-engine"
  description  = "Reasoning engine evaluated by the online evaluator"
  region       = "us-central1"
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator" "evaluator" {
  region         = "us-central1"
  display_name   = "online-evaluator"
  agent_resource = google_vertex_ai_reasoning_engine.engine.id

  config {
    max_evaluated_samples_per_run = "100"
    random_sampling {
      percentage = 10
    }
  }

  cloud_observability {
    open_telemetry {
      semconv_version = "1.39.0"
    }

    trace_scope {
      filter {
        duration {
          comparison_operator = "GREATER"
          value               = 0
        }
      }
    }
  }

  metric_sources {
    metric = jsonencode({
      predefinedMetricSpec = {
        metricSpecName = "safety_v1"
      }
    })
  }

  metric_sources {
    metric = jsonencode({
      predefinedMetricSpec = {
        metricSpecName = "final_response_quality_v1"
      }
    })
  }
}
```
## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Online Evaluator Full


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_reasoning_engine" "engine" {
  display_name = "reasoning-engine"
  description  = "Reasoning engine evaluated by the online evaluator"
  region       = "us-central1"
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_evaluation_metric" "metric" {
  evaluation_metric_id = "eval-metric"
  region               = "us-central1"
  display_name         = "Custom response quality"

  metric = jsonencode({
    llmBasedMetricSpec = {
      metricPromptTemplate = "Rate the quality of the following response on a scale of 1 to 5. Response: {response}"
    }
    metadata = {
      title = "custom-response-quality"
      scoreRange = {
        min = 1
        max = 5
      }
    }
  })
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator" "evaluator" {
  region         = "us-central1"
  display_name   = "online-evaluator"
  agent_resource = google_vertex_ai_reasoning_engine.engine.id

  config {
    random_sampling {
      percentage = 100
    }
  }

  cloud_observability {
    open_telemetry {
      semconv_version = "1.39.0"
    }

    session_scope {
      inactivity_trigger {
        threshold = "3600s"
      }

      filter {
        total_token_usage {
          comparison_operator = "GREATER"
          value               = 0
        }
      }
      filter {
        user_turns {
          comparison_operator = "GREATER"
          value               = 0
        }
      }
      filter {
        model_calls {
          comparison_operator = "GREATER"
          value               = 0
        }
      }
      filter {
        model_call_errors {
          comparison_operator = "GREATER_OR_EQUAL"
          value               = 0
        }
      }
      filter {
        tool_calls {
          comparison_operator = "GREATER"
          value               = 0
        }
      }
      filter {
        tool_call_errors {
          comparison_operator = "GREATER_OR_EQUAL"
          value               = 0
        }
      }
      filter {
        duration {
          comparison_operator = "GREATER"
          value               = 0
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # Registered metric, referencing a separate google_vertex_ai_evaluation_metric.
  metric_sources {
    metric_resource_name = google_vertex_ai_evaluation_metric.metric.id
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `agent_resource` -
  (Required)
  The name of the agent that the OnlineEvaluator evaluates periodically.
  This value is used to filter the traces with a matching cloud.resource_id
  and link the evaluation results with relevant dashboards/UIs. This field
  is immutable; once set, it cannot be changed.

* `config` -
  (Required)
  Configuration for sampling behavior of the OnlineEvaluator. The
  OnlineEvaluator runs at a fixed interval of 10 minutes.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config).

* `cloud_observability` -
  (Required)
  Data source for the OnlineEvaluator, based on the Google Cloud
  Observability stack (Cloud Trace & Cloud Logging). The data source type is
  immutable once set. Within `cloud_observability`, `log_view` and
  `trace_view` can be updated; the eval scope (`trace_scope` /
  `session_scope`) and the convention (`open_telemetry`) are immutable.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability).

* `metric_sources` -
  (Required)
  A list of metric sources to be used for evaluating samples. At least one
  metric source must be provided. Only predefined metrics (inline `metric`)
  and registered metrics (`metric_resource_name`) are supported. Every
  registered metric must have a `display_name` (or `title`) and a
  `score_range` defined, otherwise the evaluations will fail. The maximum
  number of metric sources is 25. Exactly one of `metric` or
  `metric_resource_name` must be set per metric source.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_metric_sources).


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Human-readable name for the OnlineEvaluator. The name doesn't have to be
  unique. The name can consist of any UTF-8 characters. The maximum length
  is 63 characters.

* `region` -
  (Optional)
  The region of the OnlineEvaluator (e.g. us-central1). If unset, the provider's region is used.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_config"></a>The `config` block supports:

* `max_evaluated_samples_per_run` -
  (Optional)
  The maximum number of evaluations to perform per run. If set to 0, the
  number is unbounded.

* `random_sampling` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for random sampling. This is the sampling method used to
  select traces for evaluation.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_random_sampling).


<a name="nested_config_random_sampling"></a>The `random_sampling` block supports:

* `percentage` -
  (Required)
  The percentage of traces to sample for evaluation. Must be an
  integer between 1 and 100.

<a name="nested_cloud_observability"></a>The `cloud_observability` block supports:

* `log_view` -
  (Optional)
  Optional log view that will be used to query logs. If empty, the
  project's default view (`projects/{{project_id}}`) will be used.

* `trace_view` -
  (Optional)
  Optional trace view that will be used to query traces. If empty, the
  `_AllSpans` view from the `_Trace` US bucket will be used.

* `open_telemetry` -
  (Required)
  Configuration for a data source following the OpenTelemetry
  convention. This is the convention that the data source follows.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_open_telemetry).

* `trace_scope` -
  (Optional)
  If chosen, the OnlineEvaluator will evaluate single traces matching
  the specified filter. Exactly one of `trace_scope` or `session_scope`
  must be set.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_trace_scope).

* `session_scope` -
  (Optional)
  If chosen, the OnlineEvaluator will evaluate sessions matching the
  specified filter. A session is a group of traces with a common
  `gen_ai.conversation.id`. Exactly one of `trace_scope` or
  `session_scope` must be set.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope).


<a name="nested_cloud_observability_open_telemetry"></a>The `open_telemetry` block supports:

* `semconv_version` -
  (Required)
  Defines which version of the OTel Semantic Convention the data
  follows. Can be "1.39.0" or newer.

<a name="nested_cloud_observability_trace_scope"></a>The `trace_scope` block supports:

* `filter` -
  (Optional)
  A list of predicates to filter traces. Multiple predicates are
  combined using AND. The maximum number of predicates is 10.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_trace_scope_filter).


<a name="nested_cloud_observability_trace_scope_filter"></a>The `filter` block supports:

* `duration` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the duration of a trace (in seconds).
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_trace_scope_filter_duration).

* `total_token_usage` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the total token usage within a trace.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_trace_scope_filter_total_token_usage).


<a name="nested_cloud_observability_trace_scope_filter_duration"></a>The `duration` block supports:

* `comparison_operator` -
  (Required)
  The comparison operator to apply. Possible values are:
  LESS, LESS_OR_EQUAL, EQUAL, NOT_EQUAL, GREATER_OR_EQUAL,
  GREATER.

* `value` -
  (Required)
  The value to compare against.

<a name="nested_cloud_observability_trace_scope_filter_total_token_usage"></a>The `total_token_usage` block supports:

* `comparison_operator` -
  (Required)
  The comparison operator to apply. Possible values are:
  LESS, LESS_OR_EQUAL, EQUAL, NOT_EQUAL, GREATER_OR_EQUAL,
  GREATER.

* `value` -
  (Required)
  The value to compare against.

<a name="nested_cloud_observability_session_scope"></a>The `session_scope` block supports:

* `inactivity_trigger` -
  (Optional)
  Session is considered ready for evaluation when there are no new
  traces for a specified period of inactivity.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_inactivity_trigger).

* `filter` -
  (Optional)
  A list of predicates to filter sessions. Multiple predicates are
  combined using AND. The maximum number of predicates is 10.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter).


<a name="nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_inactivity_trigger"></a>The `inactivity_trigger` block supports:

* `threshold` -
  (Required)
  The amount of time that must pass with no new traces before a
  session is considered ready for evaluation. Must be a positive
  duration no greater than 7 days (604800 seconds), e.g. "3600s".

<a name="nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter"></a>The `filter` block supports:

* `total_token_usage` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the total token usage within a session.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter_total_token_usage).

* `user_turns` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the number of user turns within a session.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter_user_turns).

* `model_calls` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the number of underlying LLM calls within a session.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter_model_calls).

* `model_call_errors` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the number of LLM call errors within a session.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter_model_call_errors).

* `tool_calls` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the number of underlying tool calls within a session.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter_tool_calls).

* `tool_call_errors` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the number of tool call errors within a session.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter_tool_call_errors).

* `duration` -
  (Optional)
  Filter on the duration of a session (in seconds).
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_cloud_observability_session_scope_filter_duration).

<a name="nested_metric_sources"></a>The `metric_sources` block supports:

* `metric` -
  (Optional)
  Inline metric config, provided as a JSON-formatted string using
  camelCase field names to match the API format (see the
  [Metric API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1/Metric)).
  The suggested predefined `metricSpecName` values depend on the
  evaluation scope configured in `cloud_observability`; a predefined
  metric must match the scope or the create request will be rejected:
    - `trace_scope` (single trace): `final_response_quality_v1`,
      `tool_use_quality_v1`, `hallucination_v1`, `safety_v1`.
    - `session_scope` (multi-turn session):
      `multi_turn_task_success_v1`, `multi_turn_tool_use_quality_v1`,
      `multi_turn_trajectory_quality_v1`.

* `metric_resource_name` -
  (Optional)
  Resource name of a registered metric (a
  `google_vertex_ai_evaluation_metric`), e.g.
  projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationMetrics/{{id}}.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/onlineEvaluators/{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the OnlineEvaluator. This is the final component of
  the resource path.
  Format: projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/onlineEvaluators/{{id}}.

* `state` -
  The state of the OnlineEvaluator. Possible values are: ACTIVE, SUSPENDED,
  FAILED, WARNING.

* `state_details` -
  Contains additional information about the state of the OnlineEvaluator.
  This is used to provide more details in the event of a failure.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_state_details).

* `create_time` -
  Timestamp when the OnlineEvaluator was created.

* `update_time` -
  Timestamp when the OnlineEvaluator was last updated.


<a name="nested_state_details"></a>The `state_details` block contains:

* `message` -
  (Output)
  Human-readable message describing the state of the OnlineEvaluator.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 60 minutes.

## Import


OnlineEvaluator can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/onlineEvaluators/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import OnlineEvaluator using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
    region = "<-optional value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import OnlineEvaluator using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/onlineEvaluators/{{name}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), OnlineEvaluator can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/onlineEvaluators/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator.default {{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_online_evaluator.default {{name}}
```
